name: meowzik
description: A music player beside the chat, after the Meowzik Discord bot: YouTube, SoundCloud, Spotify and Suno, a queue, history and favorites with no limits, loop, shuffle, autoplay, volume and seeking. Claude can play and control it too, and it installs mpv and yt-dlp when they are missing.

searchSource.title: Search source
searchSource.description: Where a song name is searched: YouTube, or SoundCloud (no login needed; it skips the 30-second previews).

cookies.title: YouTube cookies file
cookies.description: A cookies.txt (Netscape) or a browser-extension JSON export, from a throwaway account logged into YouTube. Used only when YouTube asks to confirm you are not a bot; Meowzik works on its own copy and keeps the session it rotates.

cookiesFromBrowser.title: Cookies from browser
cookiesFromBrowser.description: A browser yt-dlp reads YouTube cookies from instead of a file (firefox, chrome, edge, brave...).

ytdlpArgs.title: Extra yt-dlp arguments
ytdlpArgs.description: Added to every yt-dlp call: a proxy, extractor arguments and the like.

ytdlp.title: yt-dlp
ytdlp.description: The yt-dlp executable, by path. Empty: the standalone build Meowzik installs, which carries the scripts that solve YouTube's challenges (a pip install may not).

mpv.title: mpv
mpv.description: The mpv executable, by path. Empty: the one Meowzik installs, else mpv on the PATH.
